page.title: Bintu bia kulamakaja
page.intro: Lamakaja konte yebe ya dimanyisha. Bantu badi bafumina ku mamanyisha eba badi bafika mu My Leads nkayabu, ne mushinga ne mushinga wa muntu yonso.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form udi ulombola mu My Leads, difutu dia dituku dionso ne mushinga wa muntu yonso, ne mushinga wa bantu badi batuma ku LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).
catalog.notAvailable: Katshiena muanji kulongolola pa tshilaminu etshi to

banner.connected: LinkedIn udi mulamakaja. Badi bapeta bantu badi mua kulua mpindieu - dibeji edi nedikale dishintuluka mu katupa kîpi emu.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn ki mmulongolola pa tshilaminu etshi to. Mulombodi udi ne tshia kuela ID wa muena mudimu wa programe LinkedIn ne tshisokomenu.
banner.expired: Dilamakaja dia LinkedIn ndijike, nunku bantu badi mua kuluangana kabatu benza mudimu pamue to. Pingaja bua kutungunuka.
banner.reconnectSoon: LinkedIn udi ukulomba bua kubuela kabidi kumpala kua {{date}} . Pingaja kabidi kumpala kua dîba adi bua kulama njila idi ipita.

connect.title: Lamakaja LinkedIn
connect.intro: Buela mu konte wa LinkedIn udi ulombola mamanyisha eba. Leadrat udi ubala anu konte yebe ya mamanyisha, Lead Gen Form ne bipetu bia mamanyisha, ne utuma bantu badi bakudimune.
connect.need1: Mudimu mu tshilaminu tshia LinkedIn (Mutangidi anyi wa ku mutu).
connect.need2: Mudimu udi pa dibeji dia kumpanyi didi dilamakaja (Mulombodi, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Mulombodi wa malu anyi Mukonkononyi) - LinkedIn udi umulomba bua kuabanyangana bantu badi mua kulombola.
connect.need3: Lukonku lua nimero ya telefone mu Lead Gen Forms - bantu badi kabayi ne nimero ya telefone kabena mua kusakidila to.

connection.title: Disangisha
connection.autoRenews: Dibuela didi dipingana diakamue too ne dîba adi
connection.syncResult: Diumvuangana dienzeke: {{received}} dipeta, {{created}} difukibua, {{duplicates}} dipingana, {{rejected}} dibenga.
connection.confirmDisconnect: Kukosa LinkedIn anyi? Diumvuangana didi dijika ne bimanyinu bia dibuela bidi bijimijibua. Bintu bidi bilombola, bipetu ne mukanda wa midimu bidi bilamibua.
connection.noPermission: Udi mua kutangila dibeji edi. Bua kulamakaja ne kushintulula malu adibu balongolole bidi bikengela bukenji bua "Lama malu adibu balongolole".
connection.fetchHint: Bantu bapiabapia badi batangila kunyima kua minite mikese ne matuku 7 a ndekelu badi batangila kabidi dituku dionso, nunku kakuena tshintu tshidi tshipua muoyo to. Wenza mudimu ne bualu ebu bua bantu badi bakulombola kumpala kua wewe kubuela, anyi bua kutangila kabidi tshikondo kampanda (too ne matuku 90 musangu umue). Malu adi kale mu Leadrat adi apita.
connection.fetchResult: {{from}} - {{to}} : {{received}} mupeta, {{created}} muenza, {{duplicates}} duplicate, {{rejected}} rejected, {{skipped}} kale imported.

accounts.title: Makonte a mamanyisha
accounts.intro: Bantu badi mua kufila bintu ne bungi bua bintu bidi bienza mudimu pamue ku diambuluisha dia konte ya dimanyisha idi miteka apa.
accounts.none: Kakuena konte ya dimanyisha idi mipeta bua konte wa LinkedIn eu to. Tangila mudimu wa konte mu LinkedIn Campaign Manager , pashishe upingaje.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Ambila LinkedIn nganyi wa ku balombodi bende uvua mulue bantu ba bushuwa. Padi mulombodi LinkedIn ufika ku tshitupa tshiudi musungule kuinshi eku, Leadrat udi umumanyisha kudi LinkedIn , nunku luapolo luebe lua kampanye luleja buimpe bua mulombodi ne LinkedIn udi mua kupeta bantu ba bungi badi bu mulombodi webe muimpe. Anu ID tshia LinkedIn ne tshimanyishilu tshimue tshia e-mail ke bidibu batuma.
capi.enabled: Tuma malu adibu bakudimune ku LinkedIn
capi.created: Dishintuluka dienzeke pa LinkedIn ne difunda pa karte.
